[BLOCKER | Band 2 desktop dark & light — LAST 72 HOURS panel (right column)] Blocker #2 PARTIAL: Left panel is FIXED (commit circles, PR squares, and counts are cleanly separated with no bleed into 72h; 'private repos · sum' is untruncated; hollow dots replaced with explained solid circles/squares). However, the right 72h panel has three severe layout breaks: (a) all 3 recent-event lines clip at the right SVG edge ('restro-pv push · 11/24' loses its time; 'my-web-2026 push · 11' loses date and time); (b) row 3 ('my-web-2026 push · 11') collides directly on top of the '3 recent events · times JST' footer; (c) the chart's 'new' legend label overflows past the right border of the 72h chart box.

[BLOCKER | Band 2 mobile dark & light (560w) — LAST 72 HOURS panel (lower half)] Blocker #4 PARTIAL & Blocker #6 NOT FIXED: The large 'LAST 72 HOURS' chart box renders completely blank (no plotted event markers, no timeline axis, no event-type legend—only '-72h', '-48h', '-24h', 'now' ticks along the bottom edge) despite 3 push events from 11/24 01:59–02:46 listed immediately below it.

[BLOCKER | Band 2 mobile dark & desktop dark — muted labels and counts] Blocker #5 NOT FIXED: Dark-mode contrast on secondary labels remains severely low. In Band 2 mobile dark, right-aligned counts ('2.1kc' down to '374c', '1.5kc'), '+24 more public', 'private · sum', and '-72h / -48h / -24h / now' are barely legible against the dark card background. In Band 2 desktop dark, '+22 more public', 'private repos · sum', '352c 185p', '1.5kc 548p', and axis ticks are similarly dim. In Band 1 dark, 'C# 40.9 · C++ 7.9 · +3', 'of A+ tier', and project subtitles also remain low-contrast.

[BLOCKER | Band 2 desktop & mobile — 72h pulse event-type encoding] Blocker #6 NOT FIXED: Desktop 72h adds tiny 'push / PR / new' legend items at the top of the chart, but 'new' overflows outside the chart border and the glyphs (~3–4px) are too small to distinguish shapes reliably at a glance (with only push events plotted). Mobile 72h omits both legend and plotted points entirely.

[BLOCKER | Band 1 & Band 2 mobile (560w) — Root requirement: no information deletion] Blocker #4 PARTIAL: Dedicated 560w mobile variants fix the ~4–5px illegible text and replace 42-dot rows with horizontal bars that survive 350px. However, mobile deletes core data present on desktop: Band 1 mobile omits '45.8%', 'C# 40.9 · C++ 7.9 · +3' (leaving 3 bar colors unexplained), and 'of A+ tier'; Band 2 mobile deletes all PR counts and PR encodings entirely (showing only commits).

verdict.summary: REQUEST CHANGES. Round v3 resolves several v14 issues (Band 1 4th project visible, non-overlapping rings, labels below glyphs, flame/'204' spacing, B+ arc clearance; Band 2 left-panel dot/PR/count separation, untruncated 'private repos · sum', solid legend-backed glyphs, leftBottom rule; mobile 560w readable sizing and horizontal bar pivot), but 7 BLOCKER defects remain across both bands and viewports: (1) Band 1 desktop '27 repos · 1y' still collides over the 3rd row of dots; (2) Band 1 desktop 'my-web-2026' weight bars collide over 'personal web platform' and the bottom-right legend collides over 'After Effects' weight bars; (3) Band 2 desktop 72h event timestamps clip at the right edge, row 3 collides with '3 recent events · times JST', and 'new' overflows the chart box; (4) Band 2 mobile 'LAST 72 HOURS' chart renders completely empty; (5) dark-mode muted text/counts remain severely low-contrast (especially Band 2 mobile dark); (6) 72h event-type shape encoding is unreadable/overflowing on desktop and absent on mobile; (7) mobile variants delete PR metrics, language percentages/breakdown, and rank tier context. Blocker scorecard: #1 PARTIAL, #2 PARTIAL, #3 PARTIAL, #4 PARTIAL, #5 NOT FIXED, #6 NOT FIXED.
